What's the best way to do that, make a PR for besu group_vars https://github.com/ethpandaops/fusaka-devnets/blob/42045274008762e625e25d32556d3fb9495b403e/ansible/inventories/devnet-5/group_vars/besu.yaml#L30 ? I’m seeing mostly < 20. Is this intentional yes, this is intentional. Barnabas & Sam are working on the blob schedule proposal and it seems numbers start looking bad with more blobs Yeah we wanna get higher confidence on blob counts around ~20, rather than cranking blob counts and not having high confidence in any numbers at all the `earliest_available_slot` is the earliest available block slot we got. the `earliest_available_slot` is the earliest available block slot we got. 
We prune only blobs older than the 18d retention period, we keep blocks. 
So when we advertise a `earliest_available_slot` of 0, we are saying, we have all blocks since genesis and will be able to give you all blobs upto the current retention period
